evaluation.selection_rule: Every reconstructable local day from July 2-31, 2026. No day was selected or removed based on model performance.
evaluation.issue_time_visibility: Weather and ORD movements enter features only when their timestamp is at or before the forecast cutoff. Final cancellation and diversion labels never enter issue-time features because public event timestamps are absent.
evaluation.development_disclosure: Numerical fitting, scaling, and k selection use June only. Feature and model-family design followed inspection of the July 27 showcase day, so July is a chronological out-of-month evaluation rather than a pristine never-observed research holdout.

delay_causes.qualifier: BTS CarrierDelay can include baggage loading, crew, cleaning, fueling, or maintenance. It cannot identify baggage delay and is used only after the event.

historical_analog_model.truth_boundary: Every reference label is from June. July evaluation labels are never used to fit, tune, standardize, or select k.

limitations: The final reported BTS schedule is used as the schedule input; it is not a historical schedule snapshot.
Cancellation and diversion decisions have no public event timestamp and remain evaluator-only until settlement.
BTS has no flight-level baggage, gate, crew, or turnaround-task events.
Current weather input is point METAR observation, not time-gated forecast weather or radar.
Feature and model-family design followed inspection of the July 27 showcase day.
The batch benchmark validates forecast logic; FalkorDB persistence is tested separately by the graph-backed replay.
